title: About me
text:
Hey everybody!
My name is Louise Forster and I’m a graduate student at the University of Utrecht studying Methods and Statistics of the Behavioural, Biomedical and Social Sciences.
I’m currently in my last year of the master’s and writing my thesis at Statistics Netherlands (CBS) on predicting survey behaviour using machine learning models. At the same time I’m also following the European Master in Official Statistics (EMOS) as a specialisation.
In high school, my favourite classes were social sciences and mathematics. I have always been very interested in understanding how society works and what drives different behaviours we observe on a daily basis, whilst also enjoying the ‘puzzly’ character of solving mathematical problems. Thus imagine my suprise when i discovered that statics is a wonderful combination of both! I hope to keep learning and growing in this field, sharing my enthusiasm with others.
Please take a look at my CV where I share my experiences in the statistical field as well as educational background. My Github page has also been linked on the Home page, here i share the projects I’m working on. In case you find something interesting there, don’t hesitate to send a message! I’ll be happy to have conversation about it.
